title: Predictive value of arthrosonographic parameters for hemarthrosis in patients with hemophilia
summary: The aim of this study is to determine to what extent knee, ankle, and elbow joints with and without synovial inflammation differ in terms of stiffness and blood flow in the synovial membrane area. Furthermore, it will be investigated whether synovial inflammations detected through ultrasound diagnostics or altered stiffness and increased blood flow in the synovial membrane are predictors for future joint bleeds. Additionally, a retrospective analysis will be conducted, in which ultrasound data from six months prior will be compared with prospectively collected data. The study will compare whether synovial inflammation identified six months earlier differs from newly occurring synovial inflammation in the sonographic markers.

interventions.name: At time point T0, sonographic parameters of the elbow, knee, and ankle joints are assessed in multiple imaging planes. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients suffering from Hemophilia A and B of legal age
Exclusion criteria:
Acute injuries or joint bleeding events, other coagulation disorders (e.g. von Willebrand syndrome), neurological diseases, diagnosed cognitive impairment.
